text:
sahil: Morning team — onboarding a new customer org (nebula) needs p5/p4d/g5 capacity in eu-south-2. Account is 123456789012. Need EC2 instance quota + ENI/IP quota lifted and ENI-per-instance increases.
maya: Is eu-south-2 even offering p5/p4d today? I thought only p4d in a few regions.
lenora: AWS availability matrix shows g5 and p4d are limited; p5 is newer. We'll need a quota + region availability check + TAM contact.
ankit: FYI, networking already bit us — ENI limit per subnet and IPs per ENI hit during last burst. For model shards we need at least 8 ENIs per node.
sahil: Requesting the following from infra: 1) EC2 regional quota for p5.xlarge (and p4d) to 32 2) G5 instance quota to 48 3) VPC Elastic Network Interfaces (L-26A2E3A8) increase to 5000 4) ENI per-instance (if there's a quota) 5) On-demand instance limits and ability to reserve capacity or use capacity-optimized placement groups.
maya: Can you paste the exact service-quotas CLI command you want us to run so SRE can submit it to AWS?
lenora: I'll draft the support case text. Also request spot/ondemand split and whether we should reserve via Capacity Reservations.
sahil: CLI example:
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47B --desired-value 48 --region eu-south-2
```
(we'll swap quota-codes per resource — will include the ENI one L-26A2E3A8 etc.)
ankit: Cost note — p5s are expensive. If they want bursty inference we should propose mixed fleet: g5s for baseline + p5 for peak. Put this in the ticket.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-AWS-7217 and assigned to @lenora. AWS Support case opened: case-0abc12345.
aws-support-bot: AWS replied: 'p5 instances not currently available in eu-south-2. Recommend alternative regions or capacity placement with local AZ expansion. We can request service limit increases but physical capacity not guaranteed.'
lenora: OK. Plan: 1) open quota increases for p4d/g5 in eu-south-2 anyway 2) open cross-region fallback in eu-west-3 and ap-south-1 3) add note to onboarding runbook about ENI/IP count and capacity reservations.
sahil: Thanks. Lenora — can you cc sales so they can tell customer about potential latency cross-region? @maya add to onboarding checklist.
maya: Added to checklist and pinged sales. :thumbsup:
ankit: I'll run a cost calc for mixed fleet and post numbers to the ticket.
lenora: I'll update INFRA-AWS-7217 with the CLI commands and the list of quota-codes. Closing thread here unless more asks.
sahil: :wave:
